title: Next Workspace
description: Cycle forward to the next desktop workspace (<1ms)

title: Previous Workspace
description: Cycle backward to the previous desktop workspace (<1ms)

title: Move Window to Next WS
description: Move active window to the next adjacent workspace

title: Move Window to Prev WS
description: Move active window to the previous adjacent workspace

title: Focus Window Left
description: Switch keyboard focus to adjacent tiled window in specified direction

title: Swap Window Left
description: Swap active window position in tiling layout in specified direction (<1ms)

title: Toggle Floating
description: Toggle active window between floating and tiling mode natively in Hyprland (<0.5ms)

title: Toggle Pin Window
description: Pin active floating window so it remains visible across all workspaces

title: Center Window
description: Center active floating window on current monitor canvas

title: Toggle Split
description: Toggle Hyprland dwindle layout horizontal / vertical split orientation

title: Close Active Window
description: Close active window. If protected (kitty, brave, code, nvim), pins address and requires spoken confirm

title: Confirm Action
description: Execute pending destructive action on pinned window address within 4.0s expiration
